//: Content for ui/pet/core/24-people-of-the-world-and.js: each key is a CONTENT("key") there. tools/build_petcore.py puts it into petcore.js;
"//" keys are notes and are left out. Times are in milliseconds (a minute 60000, an hour 3600000, a day 86400000).

farmyard.name: Farmer Giles
farmyard.says: Can't keep up with it all on my own, I can't.

quests.name: Eggs for breakfast
quests.text: "The hens won't lay for me and the spuds won't dig themselves."

quests.name: That fox!
quests.text: "Gideon Fox has had three of my hens this week. Teach him a lesson."

pasture.name: Shepherd Bess
pasture.says: Mind the sheep -- they mind you.

quests.name: Shearing season
quests.text: "My shears broke. Bring me wool and I'll see you right."

quests.name: Lost lambs
quests.text: "Two of my lambs wandered off. Have a look round the Pasture for me?"

meadow.name: Beekeeper Nell
meadow.says: Bzzz. Sorry -- you get used to it.

quests.name: Flowers for the hives
quests.text: "The bees are hungry. Wildflowers, and a little comb to start them off."

quests.name: Stung
quests.text: "I've been stung something rotten. Could you brew me something?"

forest.name: Ranger Ash
forest.says: Keep to the paths. Mostly. And if you hunt with a bow, come and see me -- there's more to it than arrows.

quests.name: The trapper's trade
quests.text: "A bow's all very well, but a Hunter who can't set a snare goes hungry. Twigs and thread make a snare at your crafting bench; thread makes a net at the spinning wheel. Catch 5 creatures in them -- press Tools in a fight, or put them in your hunt plan."

quests.//: V6 (2026-10-18): Ranger Ash hands you the Bestiary -- a need of 'beat' (core/40-zzz-zc).
quests.name: Know your quarry
quests.text: "Before you go swinging at everything in my woods -- learn how it fights. Beat ten chickens, then look in your Bestiary at home. Every creature's like that: ten and you know where to hit it, fifty and what shrugs you off, a hundred and fifty and its elements. And for the patient" -- he holds up a golden feather -- "a chicken gives you this, after near a thousand of them. Every creature has something."

quests.name: Too many legs
quests.text: "The spiders and boars are taking over. Thin them out."

quests.name: The white hart
quests.text: "There's an old story about a white deer in these woods. Find everything the Forest hides."

deepforest.name: Old Mab
deepforest.says: Sit, sit. The woods talk, if you listen.

quests.name: Mushroom soup
quests.text: "My old bones want soup. Mushrooms -- and the glowing ones, for flavour."

quests.name: Tell me what you saw
quests.text: "Go deep, and tell me what you find."

quests.name: A fisherman's favour
quests.text: "My nets are torn and the market's waiting. Tuna and lobster, quick as you like."

quests.name: Build me a boat
quests.text: "Bring me the makings and I'll build you a boat -- the only way to the Misty Isle, and your first ship. Hal at the Shipyard can take it from there."

jungle.name: Explorer Reyes
jungle.says: I've mapped every inch of this jungle. Nearly.

quests.name: Samples
quests.text: "For my collection: orchids, and good mahogany."

quests.name: Into the green
quests.text: "The Deep Jungle's past the vines. Prove you can handle yourself and you can have my old machete."

crystalcaves.name: Brokk the miner
crystalcaves.says: Mind your head. And your lantern.

quests.name: Shiny things
quests.text: "Quartz, and amethyst if you find it. I'm building something."

quests.name: Rope for the shafts
quests.text: "The old shaft ropes are rotten through. New rope, and iron for the pulleys."

mistyisle.name: Castaway Finn
mistyisle.says: A ship! Well -- a boat. Close enough!

quests.name: Starving
quests.text: "Three years on fish I couldn't cook. Bring me a proper meal or ten."

quests.name: The summit
quests.text: "Show me you're tough enough, and find what the mountain hides."
